title: Clinic: listening transcripts and reading set
subject: Arabic
source: Written for arabic/y11 lesson 20 (Pupil PDF worksheet: clinic listening transcripts and reading set)
intro: Lesson 20. Our own transcripts and text. Listen for the traps: a change of mind, a negative, similar numbers, past or future.

arabic.text: لَمْ أَذْهَبْ إِلَى السُّوقِ يَوْمَ السَّبْتِ، بَلْ ذَهَبْتُ يَوْمَ الأَحَدِ.
لَا أُحِبُّ الرِّيَاضَةَ، لٰكِنِّي أَمْشِي كُلَّ يَوْمٍ.
يَبْدَأُ الدَّرْسُ فِي السَّاعَةِ الثَّالِثَةِ وَالرُّبْعِ.

questions.a: Coffee (not tea: a change of mind)

questions.q: 2. On which day did the speaker go to the market?
3. How many pupils are in the class?
4. Where will the speaker travel, and when?
5. Does the speaker like sport? What do they do?
6. What time does the lesson start?

arabic.text: يَعْمَلُ أَخِي الكَبِيرُ مُتَطَوِّعًا فِي بَنْكِ الطَّعَامِ كُلَّ يَوْمِ سَبْتٍ. يُسَاعِدُ العَائِلَاتِ المُحْتَاجَةَ، وَيُرَتِّبُ الطَّعَامَ عَلَى الرُّفُوفِ. يَقُولُ إِنَّ العَمَلَ مُتْعِبٌ أَحْيَانًا، لٰكِنَّهُ يَشْعُرُ بِالسَّعَادَةِ عِنْدَمَا يَرَى النَّاسَ يَبْتَسِمُونَ. فِي المُسْتَقْبَلِ يُرِيدُ أَنْ يَدْرُسَ الطِّبَّ.

questions.q: Where does the writer's brother volunteer, and when?
questions.a: At a food bank, every Saturday

questions.q: Give two things he does there.
questions.a: Helps families in need; arranges food on the shelves

questions.q: How does he feel about the work?
questions.a: Sometimes tiring, but he feels happy when he sees people smile

questions.q: What does he want to do in the future?
